title: Empire Amplifier: Uncovering and Contesting the Prioritization of Colonial Content on Platforms Through Community-Informed Algorithmic Auditing
reasoning: The paper focuses on auditing linguistic and colonial bias in YouTube's recommendation algorithm within the context of Kyrgyzstan. While it touches on cultural values and mentions religious practices in ethnographic observations, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical systems as a core component of the research.
